metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over Chiang Mai, Thailand during March 2024 compared to May 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Chiang Mai, Thailand (approximately 18.8°N, 98.9°E) - Time periods: March 2024 vs May 2024 - Collection: MODIS Terra AOD product (MODIS/006/MOD08_M3) for monthly aerosol optical depth - Alternative: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI aerosol data if MODIS fails 2. Masking strategy: - AOD data typically doesn't need cloud masking as it's already processed - Check for valid data values (AOD typically ranges 0-5) - May need to scale the data appropriately 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: AOD can legitimately be near 0 (clean air) - C1: No images in collection for the time period - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Result is None, NaN, or outside valid AOD range (e.g., negative or >5) - A: March 2024 AOD > May 2024 AOD - B: March 2024 AOD <= May 2024 AOD ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const chiangMai = ee.Geometry.Point([98.9, 18.8]); const buffer = chiangMai.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around city center const marchStart = '2024-03-01'; const marchEnd = '2024-03-31'; const mayStart = '2024-05-01'; const mayEnd = '2024-05-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra Monthly AOD const marchCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD08_M3') .filterDate(marchStart, marchEnd) .filterBounds(buffer); const mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD08_M3') .filterDate(mayStart, mayEnd) .filterBounds(buffer); const marchSize = marchCol.size().getInfo(); const maySize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`March 2024 Images: ${marchSize}`); console.log(`May 2024 Images: ${maySize}`); if (marchSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract AOD values const marchImg = marchCol.first(); const mayImg = mayCol.first(); // Use AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean band const aodBand = 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean'; // Check pixel counts const marchCount = marchImg.select(aodBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(aodBand).getInfo(); const mayCount = mayImg.select(aodBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(aodBand).getInfo(); console.log(`March valid pixels: ${marchCount}`); console.log(`May valid pixels: ${mayCount}`); if (marchCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Mean AOD values (scaled by 0.001) const marchAOD = marchImg.select(aodBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(aodBand).getInfo(); const mayAOD = mayImg.select(aodBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(aodBand).getInfo(); // Scale the values (MODIS AOD has scale factor of 0.001) const marchScaled = marchAOD * 0.001; const mayScaled = mayAOD * 0.001; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`March 2024 AOD: ${marchScaled.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`May 2024 AOD: ${mayScaled.toFixed(4)}`); if (marchAOD === null || mayAOD === null || isNaN(marchScaled) || isNaN(mayScaled) || marchScaled < 0 || mayScaled < 0 || marchScaled > 5 || mayScaled > 5) { console.log("Invalid AOD values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (marchScaled > mayScaled) { console.log("March 2024 had higher AOD than May 2024."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("March 2024 did not have higher AOD than May 2024."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
